faqs.question: Does the trackpad come pre-installed?
faqs.answer: Yes — the trackpad and its cable are already fitted to the palmrest assembly.

faqs.question: Will I need a technician to fit it?
faqs.answer: Fitting means transferring the keyboard and trackpad cable connections from your old palmrest, so we recommend a technician unless you're comfortable opening a laptop. We can refer one on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with a palmrest?
faqs.answer: This palmrest carries a 3-month warranty against manufacturing defects such as cracking or a faulty trackpad.
